answer: An n-scaled solvency spiral resists sybils. Each identity locks R = 0.25 x e x n (e: per-identity emission; n: live identities) at settlement. Validators withhold rewards from short escrows; three short epochs slash 10%. Adding identity n+1 lifts all reserves; marginal cost is 0.25e(n+1) + 0.25e x n, linear in n. Escrow is non-transferable, re-locked 24 epochs per top-up, so splitting one stake into parallel accounts re-posts collateral at higher n. Rewards flow like a river past funded escrow walls; short sybils lose their plume of emissions, burning farming capital.
